entities.name: War of the Gods
entities.description: A divine conflict on Theros in 4561 AR sparked by Heliod's fear and Elspeth's return from the Underworld, ending with Heliod's defeat.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who killed Xenagos, was struck down by Heliod, and escapes the Underworld wielding the Shadowspear.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The god of the sun who fears being replaced, strikes Elspeth down, and is defeated and imprisoned beneath a boulder.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of the Underworld who hates Heliod and imprisons him beneath a boulder.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: The god of fate and jailer of the titans, who leaves the Underworld and creates Calix.

entities.name: Calix
entities.description: An agent of fate woven by Klothys to pursue Elspeth, who gains a spark and planeswalks after her.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: An oracle and Elspeth's former love, whom Heliod turned into his demigod Champion.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker nightmare mage whose visions torment Elspeth and who learns of the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A mortal who ascended to godhood and was killed by Elspeth.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: A giant nyxborn hydra who laid siege to Setessa.

entities.name: Khrusor
entities.description: Heliod's spear, which shatters when it meets Elspeth's Shadowspear.

entities.name: Shadowspear
entities.description: Elspeth's new spear, made from Heliod's spear in Ashiok's nightmares and given power by believers.

entities.name: Titans
entities.description: Primal urges made flesh, sealed in the Underworld by the gods.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where the war occurs.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The realm beyond death where Erebos rules, the titans are sealed, and Elspeth is imprisoned.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: The great city from which Daxos is to remove all trace of the other gods.

entities.name: Iretis
entities.description: A budding polis that fell due to Ashiok's fear.

events.summary: Xenagos ascends to godhood and is killed by Elspeth, revealing that the gods are replaceable.
events.quote: Xenagos ascended to godhood and was killed by Elspeth Tirel

events.summary: Fearing replacement, Heliod strikes Elspeth down and casts her into the Underworld.
events.quote: Fearful, he struck her down in her moment of triumph, casting her into the Underworld to be forgotten.

events.summary: Ashiok's nightmares torment Elspeth; in one vision she seizes Heliod's spear Khrusor and a twisted version remains.
events.quote: in one of them, Elspeth seized Heliod's spear, Khrusor.

events.summary: Heliod transforms Daxos into his Champion and orders him to remove all trace of the other gods from Meletis.
events.quote: Daxos was instructed to remove all trace of the other gods from the great city of Meletis

events.summary: The other gods call their champions from the Underworld and war breaks out; rifts to the Underworld release monsters and Polukranos besieges Setessa.
events.quote: The giant nyxborn hydra Polukranos laid siege to Setessa , which was defended by Haktos .

events.summary: Klothys leaves the Underworld, leaving the titans unguarded for the first time in millennia.
events.quote: leaving the titans unguarded for the first time in millennia.

events.summary: Elspeth awakens with the Shadowspear and heads for a hidden exit, gathering followers and claiming Heliod's spear is the fake.
events.quote: Her believers gave her weapon power, and simultaneously weakened Heliod.

events.summary: Klothys weaves Calix to pursue Elspeth; Elspeth defeats him repeatedly on her way to the exit.
events.quote: So Klothys weaved her masterpiece: an agent of fate she called Calix .

events.summary: Heliod's spear shatters against the Shadowspear and the onlookers' belief makes Elspeth's lie true; Heliod yields.
events.quote: Staring down the point of a spear that was no longer his, Heliod yielded.

events.summary: Erebos places the defeated Heliod beneath a boulder and gives Elspeth safe passage back to the mortal realm.
events.quote: Erebos simply took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder

events.summary: After a brief reunion with Daxos Elspeth planeswalks away, and Calix sparks and planeswalks after her.
events.quote: a spark flared inside him, and he planeswalked after her

relations.quote: Xenagos ascended to godhood and was killed by Elspeth Tirel

relations.note: He struck her down and tried to stop her escape.
relations.quote: Heliod stood in Elspeth's way, refusing her and her followers passage out of the Underworld.

relations.note: She wove him as an agent of fate.
relations.quote: Created solely to carry out the will of Klothys, Calix pursued Elspeth to preserve that which should be.
She also clashed repeatedly with Calix, emerging victorious every time.
transformed him into his new Champion in the mortal realm.
Of Daxos , her former love, whom she was tricked into killing.

relations.note: Gives her gratitude and safe passage.
relations.quote: Erebos gifted her his eternal gratitude—and safe passage back to the mortal realm.
